selection_reason: no dataset satisfies all FRESH-PRIMARY criteria

why_other_candidates_were_not_selected.PPG-DaLiA: training, final reporting and hypothesis formation in this project; 15 subjects; PPG/ECG only second-level synchronised (A0)
why_other_candidates_were_not_selected.WESAD: training and final reporting (D3 / U1 / U2); 15 subjects
why_other_candidates_were_not_selected.WildPPG: training, final reporting and hypothesis formation (A4 / A9 / D1 / U1 / U2 / WP1 / ED2 / WD1; cited by the BF0 design document); 16 participants
why_other_candidates_were_not_selected.BIDMC: training and final reporting (D1 / D3 / U1 / U2 / MC1 / EXP-D); 53 subjects; MIMIC-II provenance
why_other_candidates_were_not_selected.CapnoBase: training and final reporting (D1 / MC1); 42 subjects
why_other_candidates_were_not_selected.MIMIC-BP: prior outcome-based model / loss / selection use in this project for PPG->ABP (A7, A8, U1, U2, EXP-D) on all 1,524 subjects (criterion 7 fails); its ECG channel and PPG->ECG outcomes were never computed; MIMIC-III provenance
why_other_candidates_were_not_selected.UCI-BP: no subject identifiers (patient-level split infeasible); also used in D3 / U1 / U2; MIMIC-II provenance
why_other_candidates_were_not_selected.VitalDB: the DP0 development source (training, development, lock); old V1 TEST NOT FRESH (DP1 audit)
why_other_candidates_were_not_selected.VitalDB residual (V0-excluded): 113 cases / 104 subjects not in V1: excluded by the frozen V0 finite-fraction rule (< 0.95); same source, devices and institution as all DP0 development data, so not an external dataset shift
why_other_candidates_were_not_selected.MIT-BIH (DESTINATION): ECG only (MLII + one precordial lead, 360 Hz); no PPG
why_other_candidates_were_not_selected.MIMIC-AFib (index only): only a header index CSV; no waveform present locally

closest_to_eligible.fails: criterion 7 (prior outcome-based model / loss / selection use in this project, PPG->ABP)
closest_to_eligible.would_otherwise_meet: simultaneous PPG + ECG, 1,524 subject ids, curated synchronisation, 125 Hz, no overlap with VitalDB, PPG->ECG outcomes never computed; ECG lead UNKNOWN locally
